Jurors whose votes correlate above 37% with each other have their weight reduced toward a single shared vote, and the correlation is computed over a window of epochs rather than per case. A farm that captures 104 seats as a result forfeits for 104 identities yet holds roughly one seat's influence, because its own consistency is what gives it away. That is 19 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
